fix(daemon): a closed daemon refuses what reaches it, and launches share one listener on its signal (candybar-testing-0x6u.3c7)

A per-launch AbortSignal.any over the scope's signal grows the heap on Node 20 and 24 even with its listener removed, and a listener per launch warns past ten on Node 20 and 22, so the launches in flight share one listener over a set.

A launch reports to the scope it started under, so one outlasting its daemon's close no longer lands in the next daemon's stats. The scope is installed last, so a build that throws leaves no live scope behind it.

handle, reply and subscribe refuse once the daemon has closed. A click runs in the turn it enters, so this one check also covers a late settings-history write.

limits.disarm() replaces the per-arm handle, and DaemonParts carries the providers once, in payloadProviders.

refactor(daemon): the daemon is a value, built and closed by the process that serves it (candybar-testing-0x6u.3c7)

server.ts is the process shell; daemon.ts builds what import built, and owns arm and close. Nothing runs at import, so a jest worker can load the daemon, drive its own request handling, close it with nothing left running, and build it again over the same storage. The shell and a test tear down by one close. Launches end at one scope in the launcher, session state stops persisting at close, and a throw anywhere in the boot takes the death funnel.

fix(doctor): the config verdict names what it judged and what named it (brandon-unfiled-3248.hpxb) (#519)

* fix(doctor): the config verdict names what it judged and what named it (brandon-unfiled-3248.hpxb)

The doctor printed a verdict about a file it never named, so a run under
an unset argument or under the environment variable could not say which
config it had judged. Both verdicts now name the file or chain, and the
spelling that won.

The render origin carries a typed target in place of a bare path, so the
source travels in the one record that holds the path and the click never
has to infer it. The precedence has one composer, used by the request
checkpoint and both CLIs. The record stays flat and additive, because
builds of either age read one unversioned state file.

* fix(doctor): an unreadable source no longer fails a click, and an empty chain says what is true (brandon-unfiled-3248.hpxb)

A record's source only labels its path, so one this build cannot read now
leaves the path standing with its source unknown instead of failing every
durable click on the session. An empty chain reads "no config file loaded":
a repository's config awaiting approval is left out of the chain, so "found"
was false.

check's fatal arm joins through chainName, and the comments and the doctor's
UI map stop naming what moved.

* fix(doctor): every chain joins through one function, and comments say what is true (brandon-unfiled-3248.hpxb)

The render cache's log lines spelled the join twice more; they go through
chainName with their bytes kept. Comments that still placed the precedence in
server.ts or said a config was not found are corrected, and the UI map's
samples show the absolute paths the row prints.

## [1.170.0](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/compare/v1.169.2...v1.170.0) (2026-10-31)

### Features

* **menu:** the menu opens with no tab open, and its timeout defaults to 120s in 15s steps ([#516](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/516)) ([8da9964](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/commit/8da9964e91dd7db20d259a81a05cf0f2328ee0c2))

feat(carousel): the standard control names the setting it changes, not its value (brandon-menus-sjhy.vxr)

{{ carousel "apply" "open" "label" }} draws ◀ label ▶. The label is required, the neighbour ring and the themeSwitcher segment are gone, and a value outside the domain counts as the first member.

feat(site): the live bar's font size is a control, and starts larger
feat(site): site:dev serves the live bar and reloads it on every rebuild
